Philips Ultra Alkaline AAA Battery 4pc Blister Pack

The Philips Ultra Alkaline AAA Battery 4-piece blister pack offers reliable, long-lasting power for a variety of household and personal electronics. Whether you need to power your remote controls, toys, clocks, or other small devices, these batteries provide consistent and dependable energy to keep your devices running smoothly.

Key Features:

  • Reliable Power: The Philips Ultra Alkaline AAA batteries are engineered for long-lasting, reliable performance across a range of devices.
  • Leak-Resistant Design: Built with a leak-resistant structure to protect your devices from damage, even as the battery is used over time.
  • Mercury-Free: These batteries are designed with the environment in mind, free from mercury, ensuring safe disposal and use.
  • Ideal for Everyday Devices: Perfect for devices such as remotes, toys, clocks, wireless keyboards, and more.
  • 4-Pack Value: The pack includes 4 AAA batteries, providing excellent value for those looking to keep multiple devices powered at once.

Specifications:

  • Battery Type: Alkaline
  • Size: AAA
  • Voltage: 1.5V
  • Quantity: 4 Batteries
  • Shelf Life: Up to 7 years
  • Mercury-Free: Yes
  • Operating Temperature: -18°C to 55°C
